title: chrysanthemum hissaricum
intro: Chrysanthemum hissaricum, commonly known as the Hisar chrysanthemum or mountain chrysanthemum, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used in Unani medicine, which is a form of traditional medicine that originated in ancient Greece, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Chrysanthemum hissaricum include its potential to reduce inflammation, lower cholesterol levels, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
